title: feat(formula, plugin-email, messaging, automation, ui)!: a template `currency` hole with no argument formats in the organization's default currency, and with none the render refuses it
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBPgpqhXpoVLpqQEw4Pge7jf)_

Fixes #26939

Ruling-ref: 6464202770
Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: updated here — content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx, content/docs/automation/flows.mdx and content/docs/data-modeling/formulas.mdx state the tenant default and the refusal; no skill under skills/** taught the dollar default (the formula skill names the formatter grammar only), so no skills/** edit

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:模板里不带参数的 `{{ amount | currency }}` 不再按美元格式化,改为按组织默认币种(`localization.currency`)格式化;邮件(含认证邮件)、流程文本槽、动作/批量动作文案三种模板方言全部生效。没有默认币种时,邮件发送/渲染以 TEMPLATE_INVALID 拒绝(不发送),流程节点失败,动作文案按原文显示。
- 为什么改:裁决 6464202770(#27119 Q2 = X)。原先默认美元是没人选过的默认值,非美元组织的金额被印成 `$`。
- 风险与回滚:BREAKING(语义变化,ADR-0087 登记 D3 条目 `template-currency-no-argument-tenant-default`)。没有设置默认币种的组织,带无参 currency 的邮件会进死信(permanent)。编写期不变,保存/发布照常接受。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts` 的 `currencyDefaultRefusal` 与 currency 格式化器;`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts` 的 render;`packages/services/service-automation/src/run-resume.ts` 的币种种入;`packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts` 的 `getTenantCurrency`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run src/template-currency-tenant-default.render.test.ts`,预期全部通过(CNY 渲染为 `CN¥1,234.50`,无默认币种时 TEMPLATE_INVALID 且不发送)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。#27217 已合入并已合并进本分支;设置读取故障被当作永久失败的残留问题已立卡 #27257。

## What changes

**One rule, every dialect.** A `currency` hole with no argument formats in the organization's default currency, the `localization.currency` setting that a currency field and a dashboard measure already display in. With no default, the render refuses the hole by name and names the remedy. Nothing formats in USD by default.

**One sentence.** `currencyDefaultRefusal(hole, currency, dialect)` (`@objectstack/formula`, exported) returns `null` for a three-capital code and otherwise the refusal. The mail dialect's remedy also names `currency:@currency_code` (#26937, merged in here); the in-app dialect's names the literal form only, because it refuses `@path`.

**How each host hands the default over.** Every server-side read goes through `resolveLocalizationContext` (`@objectstack/core`), the read a request resolves `ExecutionContext.currency` with; there is no second resolution.

- `@objectstack/formula`: `EvalContext.currency`, a reserved channel like `locale`, never bound as a root. `evaluate` refuses the sentence (`kind: 'runtime'`) when a no-argument hole meets no default; `formatValue(…, { currency })` throws a `RangeError` with the same sentence. Compile and `validateExpression` are unchanged.
- `@objectstack/plugin-email`: `RenderOptions.currency`; `render()` judges a no-argument hole before reading the amount and throws `TEMPLATE_INVALID`. `EmailService` passes `input.currency` through.
- `@objectstack/spec` (contracts): `SendTemplateInput.currency`, `RenderTemplateInput.currency`, `AutomationContext.currency`, with docs; the `TEMPLATE_INVALID` docs on `sendTemplate` / `renderTemplate` name the case.
- `@objectstack/service-messaging`: the email and inbox channels take `getTenantCurrency(organizationId)` and pass `currency` on the template arm only when the delivery's organization has one. The plugin wires it to `resolveLocalizationContext`. A refusal is graded permanent, like every `TEMPLATE_INVALID`.
- `@objectstack/service-automation`: `AutomationEngine.setTenantCurrencyResolver`, wired by the plugin. `resolveRunContext` seeds `AutomationContext.currency` once at run setup, when the context carries none; a failed or empty read leaves it unset. A resumed segment whose persisted context carries none (a run parked before this change) is seeded the same way in `resolveDecisionSegmentContext`, on a copy, so the persisted `run.context` stays as it parked. `renderFlowTextSlot` renders the authored text before it blames a translation: when both throw (a no-argument hole with no default refuses both alike), the authored refusal is the answer and no translation warning is logged. A subflow and a map child inherit it through the context spread, and a suspended run persists it with the context. `renderTextSlot` takes the currency, and every text slot passes `context.currency`: notify `title` / `message` / `actionUrl`, http `url` and headers, screen texts, end message.
- `@objectstack/plugin-auth`: the six auth mail call sites (verification, password reset, account and organization invitations, magic link, notices) reach `sendTemplate` through `withMailTenantCurrency` (`mail-tenant-currency.ts`), which the plugin wraps once around the email service it wires into the AuthManager. A call that names no `currency` gets the default of the organization it names (`organizationId`) or, for identity mail, the deployment-wide setting, read through `resolveLocalizationContext`; a call that names one keeps it, and a failed or empty read adds nothing.
- `@object-ui/core` / `@object-ui/react` / `@object-ui/plugin-grid`: `ActionRunner.setTenantCurrency`, installed by `ActionProvider` and `useActionRunner` from `useLocalization().currency` (latest-ref, like the display locale); `fillTemplateHoles` and `bulkConfirmText` pass it to the engine. `BulkActionDialog` reads it from `useLocalization`. A sentence the engine refuses is shown as written, and `fillTemplateHoles` now `console.warn`s the refusal once per distinct sentence, naming the hole and the remedy.
- Migration: semantic entry `18.template-currency-no-argument-tenant-default` (ADR-0087 D3: intent, not text, so no conversion).
- Docs: email-templates (a paragraph; #26937's "no argument formats in US dollars" sentence now points at it), flows (a bullet), formulas (a sentence).

**Census, left as they are.** These show the spelling `{{ record.amount | currency }}` and claim nothing about USD, so they stay: the spec describes in `flow-text-slot-template.ts`, `io-node-config.zod.ts` (notify, http, screen), the notify and screen node config descriptions, the semantic entry `18.flow-text-slot-single-brace-refused`, and the formula invalid-hole message. The lint fixtures and the ui `flowTextSlots` fixture stay valid because authoring is unchanged. No seeded template in the repo uses a no-argument `currency` hole.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/template-currency-tenant-default.test.ts`: CNY in `en-US` (`CN¥1,234.50`) and `zh-CN` (`¥1,234.50`), EUR, JPY; a literal code ignores the default; a root named `currency` is a value, never the default; null renders empty; refusal when the default is unset, empty, `usd` or `dollars`, whatever the value, and for the whole sentence when one hole of several has no argument; compile and `validateExpression` stay ok; `formatValue`; `currencyDefaultRefusal` per dialect.
- `packages/formula/src/template-formatters.test.ts`, `template-hole-grammar.test.ts`: re-pinned from USD to a supplied default.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-currency-tenant-default.render.test.ts`: `renderTemplate` / `sendTemplate` over all three faces, double- and triple-braced; with no default or `usd`, `^TEMPLATE_INVALID: email template contract.overdue (locale=en-US): the hole {{ planned_amount | currency }}`, naming `localization.currency`, `currency:EUR` and `currency:@currency_code`, and nothing sent; the face renderers throw; a `currency:@path` hole and a template with no no-argument hole need no default.
- `packages/services/service-messaging/src/template-tenant-currency.test.ts`: the email and inbox channels pass the delivery organization's default (exact input pinned), pass no `currency` key without one, and grade the refusal permanent.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-currency-tenant-default.test.ts`: the resolver is read once per run with the tenant id and the title renders `Won CN¥1,234.50`; a context that already carries a currency keeps it; with no resolver, no default or a throwing read, the run fails naming the hole and nothing is emitted; `renderTextSlot` pins.
- `packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/notify-currency-tenant-default.test.ts` also: a run parked with no currency resumes on a second engine with a resolver, renders `Won CN¥1,234.50`, and the persisted context stays without `currency` (red with the resume seeding removed). `end-node-refusal-translation.test.ts`: a refusal both texts share fails the run naming the hole with no translation warning (red on the old `renderFlowTextSlot`), and with `currency: 'CNY'` the zh-CN translation renders in it.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/mail-tenant-currency.test.ts`: the named organization's default is added; identity mail reads the deployment-wide one; a named currency is kept and nothing is read; no default or a failed read adds no key; other members delegate. `auth-plugin.test.ts`: the wired service is the wrapper and still reaches the transport.
- ui: `ActionRunner.copyTemplateTenantCurrency-26939`, `ActionProvider.copyTemplateTenantCurrency-26939`, `bulkConfirmTenantCurrency-26939`: confirm and success copy in the tenant default; with none, the sentence is shown as written and the refusal is logged once.

## Acceptance notes

- **Display surfaces with no default.** An action's confirm or success sentence with a no-argument hole and no tenant default is shown as written, the existing fallback for any sentence the engine refuses, and the refusal is logged. A flow `screen` text refuses the node like every other text slot. The contract review kept this split (comment 6469598248, open question answered A).
- **Mail with no default dead-letters.** A messaging delivery whose organization has no default currency records the `TEMPLATE_INVALID` as permanent, so it is not retried. Setting the default and re-sending is the remedy.
- **Residual: a settings read fault is graded permanent (#27257).** `resolveLocalizationContext` answers `currency: undefined` both when an organization has no default and when its `sys_setting` read fails (the failure is memoized for a short TTL), so within that window a templated delivery with a no-argument hole dead-letters as `TEMPLATE_INVALID`. Telling the two apart needs a core seam, filed as #27257.
- **Pending 26660 changesets.** `.changeset/26660-*.md` (from #26937, unreleased) still say "no argument formats in US dollars". `check-empty-changeset` refuses an edit to a changeset the merge base carries, so this PR's changeset says it supersedes them in the same release instead.
- **#27217 (#26948)** landed first and is merged in; its unknown-formatter refusal and this PR's no-default refusal sit side by side in `render()`.

## Verification

Head `9727b5111`, which carries main at `9ff8154cf` (#27217 included) and the review's should-fixes S1, S3, S4 and S5.

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on `2ba0895c2`: 124 derived families, each run with its exit recorded; `--ran`: 124 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN, all exit 0. Five spec-dist families first answered exit 3 because a spec source edit (the `9727b5111` fix below) had made `packages/spec/dist` stale; after `@objectstack/spec` build they reran exit 0.
- Under `os-verify-lock` on `2ba0895c2`: the build of every changed package and dogfood's dependencies; `@objectstack/spec` `check:generated` exit 0; test and typecheck exit 0 for `@objectstack/plugin-auth`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/plugin-email`, `@objectstack/formula`, `@object-ui/core`, `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/plugin-grid`; `@objectstack/dogfood` typecheck exit 0 and the full dogfood suite: 348 files passed, 3 skipped (2804 tests passed).
- CI's Test Core shard 2 on `2ba0895c2` failed one spec repo pin, `currency-mode-family-closure.pin.test.ts` rule B: the new `RenderTemplateInput.currency` doc sat within five lines of the `timezone` doc's ADR-0053 citation. `9727b5111` moves that member beside `data`. Under `os-verify-lock` on `9727b5111`: `@objectstack/spec` build, `check:generated`, `test:repo`, `test` and typecheck, all exit 0.
- Ablations: the S3 cold-resume test is red with the resume seeding removed, and the S5 test is red on the old `renderFlowTextSlot`; both are green restored.
- ESLint on the changed files: 0 errors.
